passages.text: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus was leaving the temple.
One of His disciples spoke to Him.
The disciple said, “Teacher, look at these stones.
Look at these buildings.
They are magnificent.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ λέγει αὐτῷ εἷς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ Διδάσκαλε ἴδε ποταποὶ λίθοι καὶ ποταπαὶ οἰκοδομαί

passages.text: “Do you see all these great buildings?” Jesus replied. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciple.
He said, “Do you see these great buildings?”
These buildings are large and impressive.
Not one stone here will remain on another.
People will throw down every stone.
No stone will be left standing on another.
passages.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Βλέπεις ταύτας τὰς μεγάλας οἰκοδομάς οὐ μὴ ἀφεθῇ ὧδε λίθος ἐπὶ λίθον ὃς οὐ μὴ καταλυθῇ

passages.text: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately, “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”
passages.sermon:
Jesus sat on the Mount of Olives.
He sat across from the temple.
Peter, James, John, and Andrew were with Him.
They spoke to Jesus in private.
They asked Him a question.
They said, “Tell us when these things will happen.”
They also said, “What will be the sign that all these things are about to be fulfilled?”
passages.original: Καὶ καθημένου αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν κατέναντι τοῦ ἱεροῦ ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν κατ’ ἰδίαν Πέτρος καὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἀνδρέας Εἰπὸν ἡμῖν πότε ταῦτα ἔσται καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅταν μέλλῃ ταῦτα συντελεῖσθαι πάντα

passages.text: Jesus began by telling them, “See to it that no one deceives you.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus warned them.
He said, “Be careful.
Do not let anyone deceive you.”
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἤρξατο λέγειν αὐτοῖς Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς πλανήσῃ

passages.text: Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about the future.
Many people will come using My name.
They will say, “I am He.”
They will deceive many people.
passages.original: πολλοὶ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου λέγοντες ὅτι Ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ πολλοὺς πλανήσουσιν

passages.text: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about the future.
He said, “You will hear about wars.
You will also hear rumors of wars.
Do not be afraid.
These things must happen.
But this is not the end yet.”
passages.original: ὅταν δὲ ἀκούσητε πολέμους καὶ ἀκοὰς πολέμων μὴ θροεῖσθε δεῖ γενέσθαι ἀλλ’ οὔπω τὸ τέλος

passages.text: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
passages.sermon:
Nations will fight against other nations.
Kingdoms will fight against other kingdoms.
Earthquakes will happen in many places.
Famines will also happen.
These events are only the beginning of troubles.
These troubles are like the first pains before birth.
passages.original: ἐγερθήσεται γὰρ ἔθνος ἐπ’ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν ἔσονται σεισμοὶ κατὰ τόπους ἔσονται λιμοί ἀρχὴ ὠδίνων ταῦτα

passages.text: So be on your guard. You will be delivered over to the councils and beaten in the synagogues. On My account you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them to be on their guard.
People will hand you over to the councils.
They will beat you in the synagogues.
Because of Me, you will stand before governors.
You will also stand before kings.
You will be witnesses to them.
passages.original: Βλέπετε δὲ ὑμεῖς ἑαυτούς παραδώσουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς συνέδρια καὶ εἰς συναγωγὰς δαρήσεσθε καὶ ἐπὶ ἡγεμόνων καὶ βασιλέων σταθήσεσθε ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς

passages.text: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He said the gospel must be proclaimed.
People must proclaim the gospel to all nations first.
This must happen before other events.
passages.original: καὶ εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη πρῶτον δεῖ κηρυχθῆναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον

passages.text: But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say. Instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about coming persecution.
He said, "People will arrest you.
They will hand you over to authorities.
Do not worry before this happens.
Do not plan what you will say.
When the time comes, speak the words given to you then.
You will not be the one speaking.
The Holy Spirit will speak through you."
passages.original: καὶ ὅταν ἄγωσιν ὑμᾶς παραδιδόντες μὴ προμεριμνᾶτε τί λαλήσητε ἀλλ’ ὃ ἐὰν δοθῇ ὑμῖν ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦτο λαλεῖτε οὐ γάρ ἐστε ὑμεῖς οἱ λαλοῦντες ἀλλὰ τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον

passages.text: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples about coming troubles.
He said that families will turn against each other.
A brother will betray his brother to death.
A father will betray his child to death.
Children will rise up against their parents.
Children will have their parents put to death.
passages.original: Καὶ παραδώσει ἀδελφὸς ἀδελφὸν εἰς θάνατον καὶ πατὴρ τέκνον καὶ ἐπαναστήσονται τέκνα ἐπὶ γονεῖς καὶ θανατώσουσιν αὐτούς

passages.text: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His followers.
He warned them about the future.
People will hate you because you follow Jesus.
They will hate you because of His name.
Everyone will hate you for this reason.
If you keep going until the end, you will be saved.
The one who endures to the end will receive salvation.
passages.original: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου ὁ δὲ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος οὗτος σωθήσεται

passages.text: So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples about future trouble.
He warned them about a terrible thing called the abomination of desolation.
This abomination will stand in a place where it should not be.
Anyone who reads this should understand its meaning.
When you see this abomination, act quickly.
If you are in Judea, you must flee to the mountains.
passages.original: Ὅταν δὲ ἴδητε τὸ βδέλυγμα τῆς ἐρημώσεως ἑστηκότα ὅπου οὐ δεῖ ὁ ἀναγινώσκων νοείτω τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη

passages.text: Let no one on the housetop go back inside to retrieve anything from his house.
passages.sermon:
A person may be on the roof of his house.
He must not go down from the roof.
He must not enter his house.
He must not take anything from his house.
passages.original: ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος μὴ καταβάτω μηδὲ εἰσελθάτω τι ἆραι ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ

passages.text: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
passages.sermon:
Jesus warned his disciples about a coming time of great trouble.
He spoke to people living in Judea.
He said, “If you are in the field, do not go back.
Do not return to get your cloak.”
passages.original: καὶ ὁ εἰς τὸν ἀγρὸν μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ἆραι τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ

passages.text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke about a time of great trouble.
He said those days will be very hard.
Pregnant women will suffer in those days.
Mothers who are nursing babies will also suffer.
Those days will bring misery to them.
passages.original: Οὐαὶ δὲ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις

passages.text: Pray that this will not occur in the winter.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples about a coming time of great trouble.
He warned them about days of suffering.
He told them to pray.
He said, "Pray that this will not happen in winter."
Winter would make escape and survival harder.
Jesus wanted His followers to ask God for mercy during that time.
passages.original: προσεύχεσθε δὲ ἵνα μὴ γένηται χειμῶνος

passages.text: For those will be days of tribulation unmatched from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
passages.sermon:
God created the world in the beginning.
Since that time, many things have happened.
But those days will bring great tribulation.
No one has ever seen such trouble before.
Nothing like it has happened since creation.
Nothing like it will ever happen again.
passages.original: ἔσονται γὰρ αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι θλῖψις οἵα οὐ γέγονεν τοιαύτη ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως ἣν ἔκτισεν ὁ Θεὸς ἕως τοῦ νῦν καὶ οὐ μὴ γένηται

passages.text: If the Lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is God.
God chose certain people.
These people are the elect.
Great trouble will come in those days.
If the Lord did not make those days shorter, no one would survive.
God made the days shorter.
He did this for the sake of the elect.
He did this because He chose them.
passages.original: καὶ εἰ μὴ ἐκολόβωσεν Κύριος τὰς ἡμέρας οὐκ ἂν ἐσώθη πᾶσα σάρξ ἀλλὰ διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἐκολόβωσεν τὰς ἡμέρας

passages.text: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about the future.
He said there will be a time of great trouble.
During that time, some people will try to deceive you.
If anyone says to you, “Look, here is the Christ!” do not believe them.
If anyone says, “Look, there He is!” do not believe them.
Do not trust these claims about Christ’s location.
passages.original: Καὶ τότε ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ Ἴδε ὧδε ὁ Χριστός Ἴδε ἐκεῖ μὴ πιστεύετε

passages.text: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
passages.sermon:
False Christs will appear.
False prophets will appear.
They will perform signs.
They will perform wonders.
They will try to deceive people.
They will try to deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
The elect are those whom God has chosen.
passages.original: ἐγερθήσονται γὰρ ψευδόχριστοι καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται καὶ δώσουσιν σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα πρὸς τὸ ἀποπλανᾶν εἰ δυνατὸν τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς

passages.text: So be on your guard; I have told you everything in advance.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
\r\nHe warned them about future dangers.
\r\nHe told them to stay alert.
\r\nHe said, "I have told you everything ahead of time."
\r\nHe wanted them to remember His words.
\r\nHe prepared them for what would happen.
passages.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ βλέπετε προείρηκα ὑμῖν πάντα

passages.text: But in those days, after that tribulation: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
passages.sermon:
In those days, after that time of great trouble, these things will happen.
The sun will become dark.
The moon will not shine.
The stars will fall from the sky.
The powers in the heavens will shake.
passages.original: Ἀλλὰ ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις μετὰ τὴν θλῖψιν ἐκείνην Ὁ ἥλιος σκοτισθήσεται Καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φέγγος αὐτῆς Καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες ἔσονται ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πίπτοντες Καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς σαλευθήσονται

passages.text: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of Man.
At that time, people will see Jesus.
Jesus will come in the clouds.
He will come with great power.
He will come with great glory.
passages.original: Καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλαις μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς καὶ δόξης

passages.text: And He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of Man.
He will act with great power and glory.
He will send out His angels.
The angels will gather His chosen people.
They will gather them from every direction.
They will gather them from the ends of the earth.
They will gather them to the ends of heaven.
passages.original: καὶ τότε ἀποστελεῖ τοὺς ἀγγέλους καὶ ἐπισυνάξει τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων ἀπ’ ἄκρου γῆς ἕως ἄκρου οὐρανοῦ

passages.text: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He told them to learn a lesson from the fig tree.
The fig tree has branches.
When the branches become tender, something happens.
The branches begin to sprout leaves.
You see the leaves appear.
You know that summer is near.
passages.original: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς συκῆς μάθετε τὴν παραβολήν ὅταν ἤδη ὁ κλάδος αὐτῆς ἁπαλὸς γένηται καὶ ἐκφύῃ τὰ φύλλα γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν

passages.text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about the end times.
He described signs that would happen.
He said, "You will see these things happening."
When you see these things, understand this.
He is near.
He stands right at the door.
passages.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἐπὶ θύραις

passages.text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He said, “Truly, I tell you this.”
This generation will not pass away.
All these things will happen before this generation passes away.
passages.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη μέχρις οὗ ταῦτα πάντα γένηται

passages.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking.
He is the Son of God.
He says, “Heaven will pass away.
Earth will pass away.
My words will never pass away.”
passages.original: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται

passages.text: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus said, “No one knows about that day or hour.
The angels in heaven do not know.
The Son does not know.
Only the Father knows.”
passages.original: Περὶ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ἢ τῆς ὥρας οὐδεὶς οἶδεν οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι ἐν οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ὁ Υἱός εἰ μὴ ὁ Πατήρ

passages.text: Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
\r\nHe warned them.
\r\nHe said, “Be on your guard.”
\r\nHe said, “Stay alert.”
\r\nYou do not know when the appointed time will come.
passages.original: Βλέπετε ἀγρυπνεῖτε οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ καιρός ἐστιν

passages.text: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke about the coming of the Son of Man.
He said it is like a man who goes on a journey.
This man leaves his house.
He gives authority to his servants.
He assigns each servant a specific task.
He commands the doorkeeper to stay alert and keep watch.
passages.original: Ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἀπόδημος ἀφεὶς τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ δοὺς τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἑκάστῳ τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ θυρωρῷ ἐνετείλατο ἵνα γρηγορῇ

passages.text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them to stay alert.
He said, “Keep watch.
You do not know when the master of the house will return.
The master may come in the evening.
He may come at midnight.
He may come when the rooster crows.
He may come in the morning.”
passages.original: γρηγορεῖτε οὖν οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ κύριος τῆς οἰκίας ἔρχεται ἢ ὀψὲ ἢ μεσονύκτιον ἢ ἀλεκτοροφωνίας ἢ πρωΐ

passages.text: Otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.
passages.sermon: The master may come suddenly.\r\nHe may arrive without warning.\r\nHe may find you sleeping.
passages.original: μὴ ἐλθὼν ἐξαίφνης εὕρῃ ὑμᾶς καθεύδοντας

passages.text: And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He gave them a command.
He said, “Stay alert.”
He said this to His disciples.
He also said this to everyone.
He said, “Keep watch.”
passages.original: ὃ δὲ ὑμῖν λέγω πᾶσιν λέγω γρηγορεῖτε
